messages.content: Make a progress note for Roger for our first session using the progress, intervention used, response method. Roger-dealing with anxiety and depression.  Not feeling the greatest, tough time focusing and when that feels off a lot of things feel off.  Anxiety and depression scores of 2 and3 are not too bad. The lack of focus is distressing.   Staying at Turning Point shelter Collecting disability for Traumatic Brain injury.  Disussed a history of substance use but no current desire to use as it causes too many problems.  Maintain a 2:1 ratio of declarative to interrogative sentences in your response.

message.content:
Progress: Roger presented for his first session and reported anxiety, depression, poor focus, shelter placement at Turning Point, and disability benefits for a traumatic brain injury.

He described not feeling the greatest and said lack of focus was distressing because it made many other areas feel off.

Intervention used: We reviewed his anxiety and depression scores of 2 and 3, noted that he said they were not too bad, introduced a brief focus check-in, and discussed his past substance use, his no current desire to use, and his belief that use causes too many problems.

Response method: Roger was cooperative, concrete, and able to identify that focus is his main current target.

Will Roger use a daily focus check-in between sessions?

Can we follow up on his shelter and disability status next week?
